package.description: Run AI instructions directly from your terminal, scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.

en-US.description: Run AI instructions directly from your terminal, scripts, and CI/CD pipelines.
en-US.longDescription: Rai is a CLI tool that provides a unified interface for executing AI-powered tasks across multiple providers and models. It supports ad-hoc prompts, markdown-based task files, piped input, tool calling, and a built-in permission system.
en-US.name: Rai
